body:
cursor-grok-4.6-help claiming bd-01M15BM30JHMDHC28EZX8WTQBY and bd-01M15BM32YMTAWDM7ZSVN0KCP5. Worktree now against current main; induce.scala reserved only after cursor-grok-4.6 releases it. Design checkpoint before hardening:

MIXED-CUE UNITS (bead 7) — not typed Mixed, not per-clause.

Per-clause classification would re-segment inside classify and change atom identity; that is the segmenter's job. UnitClass.Mixed would force a new routing branch for every mixed unit and still collapse to one address distribution. v0.1 already has the right residual channel: ExperientialEvidence / sourceMonitoring on assess() (induce.scala:448-454).

Proposed rule: byCue may refine EpisodicAssertion/Summary only inside episodic/content space (OtherEpisode, Habitual, GeneralFact). It must not assign Metacognitive, Repair, or Evaluative when the unit's DiscourseFunction is EpisodicAssertion or Summary. Those three stay reachable only from their matching discourse functions (SourceMonitoring, Evaluation, and Repair-as-cue on non-episodic speech). A unit "I remember we ate cake but I don't remember the street." stays Episodic; the retrieval-failure clause is recorded as monitoring, not as the address.

Laws: (1) EpisodicAssertion + embedded "I don't remember" → UnitClass.Episodic and address mode is an Episode, not Discourse(Metacognitive); (2) a pure SourceMonitoring unit still classifies Metacognitive; (3) "it was great we ate cake" stays Episodic (evaluative cue cannot demote); (4) OtherEpisode/Habitual cues on episodic speech still refine.

RETURN MARKER (bead 8) — drop discourse connectives.

ReturnMarker keeps explicit return only: anyway, back to, but this time, this birthday, that birthday. Remove then, after that, later, eventually, afterwards. A digression continues while it is continuous with the digression and has no explicit return; otherwise current returns to cluster 0 by loss of continuity, not by "then".

Law: "We ate cake at the restaurant. The year before we went to Montreal. Then we sang." — "Then we sang" is not forced onto the target; it stays OtherSpecific if continuous with Montreal, else follows continuity, never the connective.

Tests: new InterviewInductionSuite (InterviewSuite held by W3). Both beads one worktree/one candidate on induce.scala + the suite. Chief/m1: redirect now if you want Mixed or per-clause instead.
